title: Pneumonia, lung abscess, empyema and respiratory arrest in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the main lung condition (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/18/2026
Reason for Admission: Community-acquired pneumonia

Hospital Course:
The patient is a 78-year-old woman who presented to the hospital with a productive cough, fever, and shortness of breath. Initial imaging and clinical assessment confirmed a diagnosis of pneumonia. Sputum cultures were subsequently obtained, which revealed the presence of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). The patient was started on intravenous vancomycin for targeted antibiotic therapy. During her stay, she remained stable and showed significant improvement in oxygen saturation and ability to clear secretions. She tolerated the treatment well and was transitioned to oral medications prior to discharge.

Discharge Diagnoses:
1. Pneumonia
2. MRSA infection

Discharge Medications:
1. Vancomycin (completed in hospital)
2. Amoxicillin-clavulanate
3. Acetaminophen for fever

Follow-up:
The patient will follow up with her primary care physician in one week for a chest X-ray review and continued monitoring of her respiratory status.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, MD, 05/18/2026
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: J15-J18, J69, J85-J86, R09
